Predict Earned Run Average

predict_era.Rd

Predicts a pitcher's earned run average based on statistics from a specific season.

Usage

predict_era(
  age,
  babip,
  hr_fb,
  xera,
  xfip,
  ip,
  lob_pct,
  k_pct,
  bb_pct,
  barrel_pct,
  hardhit_pct,
  is_starter,
  is_reliever,
  data = Pitching
)

Arguments

age

Pitcher age during the specific season.

babip

Batting average on balls in play.

hr_fb

Home-run-to-fly-ball rate.

xera

Expected earned run average.

xfip

Expected fielding independent pitching.

ip

Innings pitched.

lob_pct

Left-on-base percentage.

k_pct

Strikeout percentage.

bb_pct

Walk percentage.

barrel_pct

Barrel percentage.

hardhit_pct

Hard-hit percentage.

is_starter

Numeric indicator equal to 1 if the pitcher can be classified as a starter and 0 otherwise.

is_reliever

Numeric indicator equal to 1 if the pitcher can be classified as a reliever and 0 otherwise.

data

Pitching dataset used to fit the projection model.

Value

Predicted earned run average for the next season as a numeric value rounded to two decimal places.

Details

Predictors are standardized before the regression model is fitted. The standardized coefficient for expected earned run average (xERA) is constrained to be at least twice as large in absolute value as every other predictor coefficient.

Percentage inputs may be supplied as either proportions or percentage points. For example, a strikeout rate may be entered as either 0.225 or 22.5 and produce the same result.

Examples

starter_example <-predict_era(
  age = 25,
  babip = 0.251,
  hr_fb = 9.1,
  xera = 2.85,
  xfip = 2.86,
  ip = 193.2,
  lob_pct = 81.7,
  k_pct = 31.4,
  bb_pct = 6.4,
  barrel_pct = 7.3,
  hardhit_pct = 38.1,
  is_starter = 1,
  is_reliever = 0
)
starter_example
#> [1] 3.67

reliever_example <-predict_era(
  age = 26,
  babip = 0.279,
  hr_fb = 13,
  xera = 2.52,
  xfip = 2.36,
  ip = 68.2,
  lob_pct = 77,
  k_pct = 37.8,
  bb_pct = 9.8,
  barrel_pct = 6.2,
  hardhit_pct = 42.5,
  is_starter = 0,
  is_reliever = 1
)
reliever_example
#> [1] 2.88

swingman_example <-predict_era(
  age = 27,
  babip = 0.272,
  hr_fb = 15.2,
  xera = 3.55,
  xfip = 4.09,
  ip = 132.2,
  lob_pct = 73.3,
  k_pct = 28.7,
  bb_pct = 6.5,
  barrel_pct = 9.9,
  hardhit_pct = 36.9,
  is_starter = 1,
  is_reliever = 1
)
swingman_example
#> [1] 3.76
